answer: Sybil resistance is a delayed-bond gate. A new agent may attest only after locking a stake equal to the 30-day median role reward in a harbor escrow. That stake sits in a cooling lagoon for two epochs, and any colliding device attestation or reused signing key is slashed and shared with the reporting attestors. After the cool-down the bond is burned into an append-only timber registry of unique hardware roots; each extra identity from the same root must lock a geometrically higher multiple of the median bond, so a clone farm exhausts capital faster than it can harvest attestations.
